Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the second half! The openers for Afghanistan, Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Hazratullah Zazai walk out. Nasum Ahmed has the new ball in hand. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now the target is a tricky one, Afghanistan will have to start well, they can't fall behind in the game early on. Bangladesh will try and do exactly that, they would look to pick early wickets and push the visitors on the back foot. Stay tuned for the second half in a bit.

Afghanistan, on the other hand, started off really well with the ball. They had Bangladesh three down before the 10th over but could not press home the advantage. The likes of Mahmudullah, Afif and Das were taking the game away from them but they did well to pull things back and have kept the hosts under 160. The visitors used as many as 7 bowlers out of which Fazalhaq Farooqi was probably the pick with a two-fer. Rashid was once again economical and Azmatullah Omarzai also impressed. However, Mujeeb Ur Rahman and Qais Ahmad did not have the best of outings and will be disappointed with how they performed.

The hosts, however, were in a position to score more than what they got, maybe around the 170-run mark. After losing three wickets quickly, Das and Mahmudullah steadied things with a good partnership. After Mahmudullah fell, Afif and Das continued the good work with Das notching up his fifty. However, when it was time to get going, both fell in quick succession. Bangladesh though, courtesy of a few handy runs from the lower-order batters, have finished above the 150-run mark.

A really good first half of cricket! In the end, we believe, it is quite even at the moment. Bangladesh have got a score that is above the average first innings score here but one would not say it is par, although, it is a competitive one.

FOUR! EDGY! Bangladesh won't mind it though. Short and angling away from the batter, outside off, Shoriful Islam stands back to pull but it takes the top edge and flies behind short third man for a boundary. Bangladesh finish on 155/8.
Shoriful Islam is the number 10 batter for Bangladesh.

OUT! RUN OUT! Rashid Khan is at it again. This one is around off, on a length, Mahedi Hasan swings his bat at it and mistimes his shot aerially towards wide mid off. They attempt for the second run as Rashid Khan rushes to the ball from long off, collects and sends in a rocket throw to the keeper who breaks the stumps. It's referred upstairs and Mahedi Hasan is gone in the replays.
Short and wide outside off, Nasum slaps it to extra cover for a single. Mohammad Nabi had thrown the ball to the bowler who failed to collect otherwise it would have been another run out.
Short in lenght, around leg, it's pulled in front of square leg for a couple of runs.
Nasum Ahmed walks in next.

OUT! Yasir is run out! Great presence of mind from Rashid Khan. Fuller in length and around off, Mahedi Hasan drills his drive down to wide long off. They collect a single and Yasir Ali wants the second run too. Mahedi though has seen Rashid Khan attacking the ball and sends his partner back. Rashid is aware of the situation and fires in a flat throw to the keeper who does the rest. Yasir Ali is found short in the replays.
Appeal for a run out...
Four leg byes! On a length and around off, Mahedi Hasan shuffles across with his attempted paddle shot. Fails to middle and it goes off his pads to fine leg for a boundary.

FOUR! Smashed! Fazalhaq Farooqi again bowls a quicker one and suffers. Serves it full and around off at 139 clicks, Yasir Ali steps back and plays a blazing drive down to wide long off for a boundary.

FOUR BYES! Fazalhaq Farooqi clocks 139.7 kph and tricks both the batter and the keeper. Spears it full and around leg, Yasir Ali clears his front leg and attempts to heave but misses. Rahmanullah Gurbaz is also surprised by the extra pace and fails to collect the ball. It deflects behind off his gloves to find the fence.
Play and a miss! Fazalhaq Farooqi continues to bowl slow, digs it in short around off, Yasir Ali is early into the pull shot and hence misses.
Back of a length around off, cutting away late, Mahedi taps it down to short third man for one.
Slower one, a cutter outside off, Yasir throws his bat at it and edges it towards short third man. The fielder collects it with his left hand and they cross for a single.
A low full toss around off, Mahedi pushes it down to long off for a single.
Fuller and around off, nipping in sharply, Mahedi fails to flick and is pinged on the pads. The ball deflects to point and they cross as the bowler puts in a lone appeal. Going down leg.
Slower one at 119.8 kph, on a good length and outside off, Yasir stays back and forces it through covers for a single.
On a length and around off, Mahedi drops it with gentle hands to point for a quick run.
Short and around off, Yasir pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mahedi Hasan is the new batter at number 8.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another set batter is sent packing and Bangladesh are once again losing the plot after a partnership. This one is on a length, around off at 136 kph, Afif Hossain attempts to heave it across the line but it takes the upper half of his blade and flies towards extra cover. A simple catch for Mohammad Nabi and Bangladesh lose their sixth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nabi b Azmatullah Omarzai

Commentary.Commentary: Full and around off, stroked through covers for a single.
Debutant Yasir Ali walks in next. Azmatullah Omarzai is also back into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! Change in pace has eventually done the trick for Fazalhaq Farooqi and he screams in joy. This was turning out to be an expensive over but he ends up with the prized scalp of Liton Das. Short in length, around leg at 104.7 kph, Liton Das hangs back to pull but ends up top-edging it to the left of short fine leg. Azmatullah Omarzai moves across swiftly to complete the catch. That's a big blow to Bangladesh, perhaps will cost them 25-30 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Azmatullah Omarzai b Fazalhaq Farooqi

Commentary.Commentary: Mid off drops back.
Aims for a yorker but ends up dishing out a low full toss, around off at 141 kph, Liton hits it over wide mid on and will get only a couple as it's mopped up brilliantly in the deep.
Fuller and outside off, at 140.9 kph, Liton drills his drive through covers and collects a couple of runs.
FOUR! Edgy! Back of a length, around off and angling away at a slow pace, Liton tries to smash it through the line but it flies off a thick outside edge. Clears point and races away to the fence.
A bumper around middle at 114 kph, it goes way over the head of the batter who leaves it alone. Called a no ball as it's the second bumper of the over. Free Hit coming up...

Slow again, this time it's a bouncer around off at 110 kph, Afif leans back and attempts to ramp it over the keeper but misses. The keeper stretches to his right to collect the ball and the batters decide to steal a bye.
Starts with a slower one, on a length around off, angling in at 110 kph, Afif drags his attempted heave down to wide long on and collects a couple of runs.
Fazalhaq Farooqi is back on. 1 for 9 in his 2 overs so far.
Around off, Das shuffles across the stumps to work it away but only manages to defend it back to the bowler. Rashid Khan is done with the ball, 4-0-15-1. Exceptional, as always.
A near-yorker outside off, Liton digs it out from the bottom part of his blade. It goes behind on one bounce to the keeper.
Short in length around off, Hossain goes back and cuts it past the diving point fielder for one.
Too full and around leg, Afif clips it gently through mid-wicket and rushes back for the second run.
Gem! A googly from Rashid, full and around off, Afif Hossain has not picked it. Tries to defend but is beaten on the outside edge.
A touch short and wide outside off, Das steps back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
A dot to end but a productive over for Bangladesh! Afif looks to play the paddle scoop, this is bowled outside off, he tries to hit it towards third man but misses.
That was risky for only one! Das shuffles across and this is full and on middle, he flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
A crowd catch there! Fuller and on middle, Das jams it out on the bounce to point.
Fuller and on off, Afif Hossain pushes it towards cover for one.
FOUR! That has been hit with disdain! Short and it sits up to be hit. Afif stands tall and hammers it through covers. Bangladesh once again looking to get a move on.
Two! Outside off, this is hit through point for two.
A single to end the over then! On off, this is pushed down the ground for one at long off.
On middle, defended.

Fifty for Das! No matter where he bats at the moment, he is scoring runs. His good form continues but he would know his job is not done yet. Needs to stay there till the end. He gets to the milestone by pushing this down to long on for a single.

NOT OUT! That has just, JUST, pitched outside leg - a matter of millimetres. Afghanistan lose a review this time. It is on the pads, Hossain looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. Rashid makes a huge appeal as the batters go for one. The umpire turns it down. Rashid convinces his skipper to review it and Nabi does. They end up losing one. Bangladesh have brought up their 100!
4th review of the game! Another one from Afghanistan and another one for LBW as another appeal is turned down.
Das moves on to 49! A full toss, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Leading edge but safe! On off, Hossain looks to flick, this one spins away. It goes off the leading edge towards mid off for one.
Rashid is back! 2-0-1-7 for him so far.

FOUR! That is wonderful placement! A boundary to end the over and it is a really good one for Bangladesh. Nabi did come back well after going for 6 on the first two balls but the last ball has spoilt it. Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket. No chance for the fielders at long on and deep mid-wicket.
A single now! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
This one stays low! Quicker and on off, this one does not bounce a lot. Afif cuts it to point. The pitch is playing its tricks.
That has taken off! This lands on off and then takes off. Afif looks to defend but it hits him on the left bicep.
Good placement and two more! Afif comes down the track and pushes it wide of long off for two.
FOUR! Nice and fine! A boundary to begin the 13th and a welcome one. On the pads at 98.2 kph, Afif works it fine, this one races away to the fine leg fence.
A single to end! On the body, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
A full toss, Das pushes it through covers for one.
A good slower bumper, on the body, it is fended away towards short fine leg for one.

NOT OUT! It is clipping the top of the leg pole! Umpire's call it is! Not a bad review, to be honest. Could have gone either way. This is on middle, angling into the batter from around the wicket. Hossain comes forward and looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The question is asked but the umpire rules it in the favor of the batter. Janat likes it and he wants it to be reviewed. Nabi does so but the replays show that the on-field call will remain. Afghanistan do not lose their review.
Third review of the game! This time by Afghanistan. A huge appeal for an LBW is not given. Looks a touch high but could be a good review.
Well fielded there by Azmatullah Omarzai! Shorter and outside off, Das guides it towards backward point. The fielder dives to his right and saves at least two.
On middle, Hossain works it towards mid-wicket. They take one, think of a second but it is not on.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is back on to bowl his last. Hang on, he was initially given the ball but now it is thrown to Karim Janat who will bowl his first.
Afif is off the mark! On middle, he works this through mid-wicket for one. End of an action-packed over, 10 runs and a wicket from it.
Afif Hossain walks out to bat!

OUT! LBW! Azmatullah Omarzai gets the wicket Afghanistan desperately needed. This pair was really taking the game away from them. A good change in bowling and a good comeback by Azmatullah Omarzai who would have been under pressure after going for 9 runs in the first 4 balls. The debutant surprises the batter there, he was going short so far but this time goes really full, also gets it to tail back in from outside off at 139.5 kph. Mahmudullah looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised. The Bangla skipper knows that he is a sitting duck and hence walks back even without thinking of a referral. Can Afghanistan now build on this?
That one stays low! Shorter and on middle, this one stays a touch low. Das looks to pull but it goes off the under edge towards short fine leg for one.

SIX! Over the fence! That is a poor delivery, it is short and it sits up to be hit, outside off, Das cuts. It flies over point. The umpire is not sure whether it has gone all the way, the replays show it has. Runs flowing now.
Short again and on the body, this is pulled again towards deep square leg, only one.
On the bounce! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled but towards deep square leg for one.

DRINKS! That last over has probably shifted the momentum now towards the hosts! Before that, Afghanistan had a hold over this game, they had got three and were not letting Bangladesh score freely. They though would know one more wicket and the game once again would be in their control. The hosts, on the other hand, will hope this partnership can go on for longer. Azmatullah Omarzai to bowl after the break.

SIX! High and handsome! The Bangla skipper goes big this time and dispatches it into the crowd. Full and around off, in the slot for the batter, Mahmudullah goes down and muscles it over mid-wicket. 17 from the over and Bangladesh are 71/3 at the halfway mark.
Goes on the back foot and forces it through covers for a run.

Floated and full, around middle, Liton eases it down towards wide long on. There is some miscommunication in the deep between the two fielders and there is a chance for the third run but Liton slips while turning.
Two more. Very full and around off, Liton slogs it off the bottom half towards wide long on. Darwish Rasooli makes a fine diving stop and they take a couple of runs.
SIX! That's dismissed! Qais serves it a little too full around off, Liton kneels down and smokes it over mid-wicket for a maximum. 88m on the radar!
Short in length, outside off and spinning away, Liton cuts but finds the point fielder.
Rashid drops it short and on off, Das pulls it in front of square leg and collects another single in the over.
Aerial but safe! Loopy and full, landing outside off, Mahmudullah goes down and heaves it over mid-wicket. It goes on one bounce to the fielder and they collect a run.
Flatter and shorter on off, Mahmudullah goes back and punches it towards extra cover.
Use of the wrists by Liton as he works it through mid-wicket for one.
A googly, reaching the batter on the full, Das knocks it down to long on for a run.
Short and around off, Das goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run. 50 comes up for Bangladesh!
Change! Rashid Khan returns to bowl his second over.
Fuller and on off, clipped through mid-wicket for another single. End of a successful first over from Qais.
Around middle, helped towards short fine leg for a run.
Skipper Mahmudullah walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Qais Ahmad has hunted down the big fish and raises his arms in triumph. A flighted delivery, landing full around leg at 89.3 kph. It's perhaps the googly. Shakib Al Hasan goes down to sweep it across the line but plays too early and ahead of himself. The ball arrives a bit late to take the top edge and it's a simple catch for Mujeeb Ur Rahman at short fine leg. Bangladesh are in big trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Mujeeb Ur Rahman b Qais Ahmad

Commentary.Commentary: A long hop around off, Liton goes back and pulls it to long on for a single.
Flighted and around off, fuller in length, Das drives it to extra cover.
Short and on middle, Shakib goes back to cut and places it towards point for one.
Bowling change. Qais Ahmad to bowl now...
Flatter and around off, it's punched aerially over extra cover for a single.

The fielder tries to be cheeky but ends up conceding an extra run. Full and flighted around off, Shakib Al Hasan jumps down the track and chips it over the bowler's head for a couple of runs. The long on fielder comes across to his right, slides and then needlessly tries to parry it to Rashid Khan coming in from long off. He ends up throwing it wide of Rashid and the batters get the third run.
A touch short again, around off, Liton plays late and guides it to the left of short third man for a run.
Nabi drags his length short and delivers it wide outside off, Shakib goes back and cuts it to deep point for one.
Floated and full, landing around off, Shakib Al Hasan defends it back off the front foot.
Loopy and full around off, Liton Das clips it through the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Mohammad Nabi to bowl after the Powerplay.

BEATEN! Shorter and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to cut but the extra bounce means it goes past the outside edge. A really good 6th over for Bangladesh but overall, the Powerplay has been dominated by the visitors. The hosts are 37 for 2.
A fumble and a run! On off, Das pushes it towards cover for one.

FOUR! Up and over! Once again, another beautiful shot. Das makes room and Mujeeb goes full and on off, Das lofts it over mid off for another boundary. Picked his spot well, knew he just had to time it good enough to clear the in-field.
WIDE! Down the leg side this time, Das looks to pull but misses.
On off, Das drags it wide of deep square leg for two.
That stays low! On middle, Das makes room, he looks to cut but this one does not get up. It goes off the under edge back towards the bowler.

FOUR! Beautifully played! What a shot. Indicates the kind of form he is in. Das makes room, this is on middle, he pushes it past covers and into the fence. There were two fielders but he finds the gap brilliantly.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out to bat!

OUT! THREE REDS! Not sure why Munim Shahriar reviewed that. If he did not hit it, it was dead plumb. His entertaining little innings comes to an end and he also takes a review along with him. The debutant looks to go after Rashid. Shuffles across and tries to play the sweep. Picks the wrong length as this is very full. He misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised. Munim Shahriar reviews. Munim Shahriar reviews. UltraEdge shows no bat and Ball Tracking shows three reds. Bangladesh are in trouble now. Rashid does not take long to make an impact.
Another review! This time from Bangladesh. Munim Shahriar has been given LBW. He might have hit it otherwise he is out.
On the pads, Das looks to sweep, he misses, it hits the pad and rolls behind. A run is taken. Leg bye.
Just another one! On middle, this is flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Takes one now! Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Yet again, Rashid goes very full and on off, Das hits it crisply but straight to the fielder at cover. Two dots to begin.
Das misses out! It is a half volley! Outside off, Das drives but to covers.
Rashid Khan is on now! It just gets tougher for Bangladesh.
Another dot to end so a very good comeback by Mujeeb. This is on middle, Munim Shahriar plays it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Munim Shahriar looks to go for the slog sweep again but misses.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
FOUR! Clipped away! Back-to-back boundaries and the last boundary has probably got Munim Shahriar going! On the pads, this is clipped fine on the leg side and it races away.
FOUR! Munim Shahriar finally gets hold of one! Brings out the slog sweep, gets the length he wants, fuller and on off, it is hit hard through wide mid on for a boundary.

A leg bye to end a successful over! That was a hoick from Munim! A slower one on the pads at 110.8 kph, Munim Shahriar looks to heave it on the leg side but misses. It hits the back leg and rolls on the off side. A run is taken. Munim Shahriar has played quite a few shots but not to great effect.
Really good stuff from Das! Length and on off, he drops it towards cover and takes one quickly.
Another lovely delivery! Fazalhaq Farooqi continues to impress! Length and on middle, this lands and moves away. Das looks to defend but it hits the gloves and lands short of first slip.
Munim Shahriar is looking to go big here. He though is done in a touch by the slower one, adjusts well and works it towards short fine leg for one.
A quick run! On the pads, Das nudges it to short fine leg and takes one. He is off the mark.
Liton Das walks out to bat!

OUT! THREE REDS AND AFGHANISTAN HAVE STRUCK EARLY! Mohammad Naim, who had a poor BPL, falls for a low score in the first game here. Excellent cricket from the visitors. First Fazalhaq Farooqi sees Naim shuffle across and spears in a near-yorker, it tails back in from outside off at 141.5 kph. Naim looks to jam it out, it either goes off the pad or the bat down to third man and the batters cross. The bowler puts in a loud appeal but it is turned down. Nabi, after a chat, reviews. Replays roll in and they show the onfield call needs to be overturned. Elation for Afghanistan. Just the start they would have wanted.
Review time! A huge appeal for an LBW but it is turned down. If it is not bat, it seems out.
Tidy from Mujeeb, to begin with! Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Mujeeb gets away with it! This is on the pads, Naim flicks it hard but towards deep square leg for only one.
Munim Shahriar shuffles across, probably looking for the slog sweep, he realises the length is not right and smartly nudges it on the leg side for one at square leg.
Fuller and on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
And again, gets it to tail back in from outside off, really full, this is worked through mid-wicket. Shahriar wants two but is sent back.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl from the other end then!
An in-dipper, this comes back in from outside off, flatter. Defended.
End of an exciting first over from Fazalhaq Farooqi! Length again and on off, defended.
Another good delivery! Length and on off, this one comes back in a touch. Naim looks to push it on the off side but gets an inside edge.

Edged but wide of the slip fielder! Another lovely delivery. Farooqi has learnt quickly, after being dispatched for a boundary, he goes back of a length on the next two balls. This moves away. Munim Shahriar pokes at it, it goes off the outside edge, wide of the slip fielder and down to third man for one.

Extra bounce! That is a really good effort delivery. Fazalhaq Farooqi bends his back and bowls it shorter and on off, Munim Shahriar looks to fend it away, it goes off the gloves and lands well short of the widish first slip fielder.

FOUR! Up and over! Munim Shahriar begins his career for Bangladesh with a boundary. Not off the middle but gets enough to clear the in-field. Fuller and outside off, in the zone. It is lofted over covers, more off the toe end but a boundary.
BEATEN! That is a beauty! It swung a long way. It starts around middle and leg. Moves away a long way. Munim Shahriar has a poke at it but is beaten.
WIDE! Bangladesh are underway courtesy of an extra! It could have been a lot more though. That was short and down the leg side. Munim Shahriar looks to pull but misses. Wided.

All set to get underway! Mohammad Naim and Munim Shahriar, the debutant, are the openers for the home team. Fazalhaq Farooqi, who had a terrific ODI series, will kick-start the proceedings. The countdown is over, let's play...

Mohammad Nabi, the captain of Afghanistan, says that he would have batted first as well. Tells that they want to build a quality team for the World Cup and it's going to be good preparation for them. Mentions that he is really happy with his playing XI and he too informs that they have a couple of debutants in Azmatullah Omarzai and Darwish Rasooli.

Mahmudullah, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that the pitch looks quite good and hopes to put up a good total on the board and then defend it. Adds that with the T20 World Cup coming up next, they need to build well and Afghanistan are a great challenge. Informs about the two debutants in Munim Shahriar and Yasir Ali.

Pitch report - It's hot and humid out there. There is live grass and the pitch is quite firm. Overall, 145 has been the par score here but in the last few games, 123 has been the average score. Spinners will have their say but the pacers will also have a role if they execute their variations.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Hazratullah Zazai, Darwish Rasooli (On debut), Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi (C), Karim Janat, Rashid Khan, Azmatullah Omarzai (On debut), Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fazalhaq Farooqi, Qais Ahmad.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Liton Das (WK), Mohammad Naim, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Munim Shahriar (On debut), Mahedi Hasan, Yasir Ali (On debut), Nasum Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.
Toss - Mahmudullah is lucky as the coin falls in his favour. BANGLADESH ELECT TO BAT!

Update - Mushfiqur Rahim sustained an injury on the thumb of his right hand during one of the practice sessions yesterday and won't be available for this game. He underwent a scan but that revealed nothing serious. The pain however is still there, so he is sitting out as a precautionary measure.

Afghanistan were floored in the ODI series but a win in the last match would have given them the confidence that they will carry into this contest. In the head-to-head battle, the Afghans boast a 4-2 advantage over the home team in T20Is and would like to maintain the upper hand. Bangladesh's struggle is unreal in this format. They have some of the celebrated names in the ranks but somehow, they have not delivered consistently. It was a flop show from them in the recently concluded T20 World Cup and will have to come up with a better strategy. Let's see what is in store. Toss and other updates coming up shortly...

Welcome, folks! This is the second leg of the Afghanistan tour to Bangladesh and they have shifted base from Chattogram to Shere Bangla National Stadium in Dhaka. It's the shortest format of the game now where both teams have had a fair share of struggles of late. They are trying out a few different combinations in this series to revive their fortunes. The Bangla Tigers are currently on an 8-match losing streak and would be eyeing an end to this unfortunate run. Will that happen this afternoon? Stay tuned to find out...
... MATCH DAY ...
